SELECT ul.*, cs.evo_api_url, cs.evo_api_key
FROM unhabella_leads ul
JOIN clientes_sistema cs ON cs.instancia_whatsapp = ul.instancia
WHERE ul.instancia = 'unhabella' AND ul.status = 'fotos_enviadas'
AND (
  (ul.followup_1_enviado = false AND ul.proximo_followup_1 <= NOW())
  OR (ul.followup_2_enviado = false AND ul.proximo_followup_2 <= NOW())
  OR (ul.followup_3_enviado = false AND ul.proximo_followup_3 <= NOW())
)
LIMIT 10;

UPDATE unhabella_leads SET
  followup_1_enviado = CASE WHEN {{ $json.followup }} = 1 THEN true ELSE followup_1_enviado END,
  followup_2_enviado = CASE WHEN {{ $json.followup }} = 2 THEN true ELSE followup_2_enviado END,
  followup_3_enviado = CASE WHEN {{ $json.followup }} = 3 THEN true ELSE followup_3_enviado END,
  ultima_interacao = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.lead_id }};

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS unhabella_leads (
  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  telefone text NOT NULL,
  instancia text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unhabella',
  status text DEFAULT 'novo',
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE unhabella_leads
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS instancia text DEFAULT 'unhabella',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status text DEFAULT 'novo',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS produto_interesse text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ultima_interacao timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS proximo_followup_1 timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS proximo_followup_2 timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS proximo_followup_3 timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS followup_1_enviado boolean DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS followup_2_enviado boolean DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS followup_3_enviado boolean DEFAULT false;
UPDATE unhabella_leads SET instancia='unhabella' WHERE instancia IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_unhabella_leads_telefone_instancia ON unhabella_leads(telefone, instancia);
